title: Yummy Rich Indian Chicken Biryani
description: A nostalgic north Indian biryani packed with gooey spice, star anise, and a mother‑sauce base, served in individual mini cocottes.

ingredients.name: spice mix
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp red chili powder, 1 tsp salt

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together yogurt, tomato puree, garlic, ginger, and spice mix until smooth.
Add diced chicken to the bowl, coat thoroughly, and let marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium‑high heat; add sliced onion and sauté until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Pour the marinated chicken and its sauce into the skillet, stir and cook for 8 minutes until the chicken is almost done.
Rinse the rice until water runs clear, then add it to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Add 200 ml water to the skillet, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Sprinkle star anise over the top, cover with foil, and let the dish steam for an additional 5 minutes off the heat.
Remove the foil, fluff the rice gently with a fork, and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Transfer the contents into individual mini cocottes, sealing each with a metal lid.
Serve the biryani hot, optionally with a side of raita or yogurt dip.
